block_scope: Three sequential measurement blocks per mode in one process; actual full-context setup is prepared once per mode. No independence or accuracy bound is claimed.
load_scope: Whole-run interval averages including actual full-context preparation; not per-call load, not an idle-box verdict or an accuracy bound.
observations: observed_* are actual ABI sequence stats: the adopter, restored sequence, or an adopter of the newly frozen empty Begin prefix. call_budget is the target's pre-existing adopt budget or the restore/Begin budget.
